largeheadline.line1: System 9

text_1080376809.text:
Proactive device maintenance 

  • Gain visibility to devices trending towards a
    sub-optimal state
  • Remove devices from rotation, which may help reduce downtime events
  • Schedule preventative maintenance services by need, not assumption

text_1313605239.text:
Balanced product use

  • Better rotate handpieces to help increase overall
  • Equipment utilization
  • Lessen the strain placed on individual devices

text_207541399.text:
Spend justification of capital assets

  • Avoid the risks of running too lean
  • Validate capital equipment needs
  • Leverage information to inform and influence case scheduling

text_316233672.text:
Simplified service

  • Submit maintenance requests with a click of a button
  • Monitor loaner deployment within your facility
  • Access service history records to assist with compliance and internal reporting

text_519525119.text:
Asset tracking

  • Monitor individual and comparative fleet data
  • Save time locating devices through "last seen"
    location information

pageshortdescription.shortDescTop: Originated through research and guided by our customers, we are pleased to offer Smart Equipment Management (SEM), a revolutionary, web-based solution designed to help you optimize the management of Stryker's smart devices through device-derived, actionable data.
